selection_metric: rolling-origin CV (3 expanding folds over the first 85% of rows) -> pooled out-of-fold predictions; per horizon compare persistence, shrunk LSTM, recent trend, seasonal naive; a candidate replaces persistence only with >=2.0% pooled MAE skill, wins in at least 2/3 of folds, and a block-bootstrap 5th-percentile skill > 0. The final 15% is reporting-only.
label_policy: Calendar-day targets use the first observed storage on or after t+h, within 1 day(s); origins without a match are omitted
test_policy: final chronological 15% holdout; reporting only, never model or strategy selection

test_diagnostics: test coverage is under one year; R2 may be unstable for low-variation series
